other_conditions: Units must have been operating for at least 3 years
Units must not be covered under the Goa Sick Industrial Unit Revival and Rehabilitation Scheme, 2008 or any other scheme in force during the tenure of this scheme
Units must be permanently registered with the Directorate of Industries, Trade and Commerce
Eligibility includes partnership firms and private limited concerns
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹1,00,00,000 capital contribution per unit with a guaranteed return of 6% for up to 5 years.
